primary_claim: Natural Language Autoencoder (NLA) verbalizations of a model's activations reveal the model's eventual answer at a rate that increases with token position and is higher when the underlying response is correct; NLA outputs become degenerate (repetition, garbled tokens, emoji blocks) only for activations from incorrect responses, and reconstruction loss is about 30% worse for incorrect than correct activations.

effect.metric: NLA reconstruction loss (correct vs incorrect activations)
effect.value: incorrect-response activations reconstruct ~30% worse than correct-response activations

stated_future_work: investigate further the impact of model response correctness on NLA
investigate with bigger models (applying for bluedot rapid grant)
cluster NLA sentences and label them
limitations_stated: the NLA was trained only for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; the smaller model might exhibit issues (e.g. incoherent AV responses on incorrect outputs) that may not occur in bigger models
quote: Incorrect activations reconstruct ~30% worse than correct ones
